title: Ectomorphs can NEVER get buff, ripped & strong (Nattyornot.com)
summary: NH takes apart a 'brutally honest' Nattyornot.com article claiming ectomorphs can never get big because of slim bones, short muscle bellies and low testosterone. He argues somatotypes don't exist, that bone size changes only how big you look, not how much muscle you can build, that insertions only change a muscle's shape, and that skinny guys need patience, lifting and a small surplus rather than a dirty bulk. He uses his own thin frame and 6.25-inch wrists as proof.
claims: Somatotypes such as ectomorph, mesomorph and endomorph aren't real categories; skinny guys use 'ectomorph' as an excuse
'Brutal honesty' framing is usually a way to dress up nonsense as a truth too harsh to accept
Thin bones don't stop you building muscle; he has small bones and a narrow frame, with tiny wrists, ankles, knees and narrow shoulders, and still got big
His biceps insertion is medium to slightly short, fitting two fingers on the tendon, and the muscle is still big; insertions change a muscle's look, not its potential size
There's no proven link between being skinny or tall and low testosterone; skinny guys usually just don't eat enough to turn training into muscle
You won't gain muscle while constantly in a calorie deficit
Training itself raises your testosterone over time
A thicker bone pushes the same amount of muscle outward so it looks bigger, but the person doesn't build more muscle
Michael Jordan was around 6'6", average for today's NBA where the mean is about 6'8", and he dominated through hard work
Most people don't know their real insertions; muscles he thought had bad insertions turned out fine after 1.5-2 years of training them
Short hamstring or biceps muscle bellies can actually look great once trained, because the mass stacks into a high peak
Most people who think they have high lats just haven't trained them enough to see them
Natural test boosters are either disguised steroids or junk; focus on training instead
Muscle responds to how long testosterone is elevated, not to spikes; a natural's steady daily testosterone accumulates like an anabolic bank
One steroid cycle does little; enhanced lifters get big from many cycles over years
A natural man should never be outsized by a woman; if that happens, he isn't training enough
Only about 0.1-1% are genetic freaks; most people are average, and he calls himself average yet is bigger than 99% of the population
He was a skinny 'pure ectomorph' with spaghetti arms and small legs, and has pictures showing his change
Anyone can lose weight; being fat is your own responsibility
Skinny guys shouldn't dirty bulk or bulk aggressively; they just get skinny-fat. Use a small surplus, lift hard and be patient
In a small surplus, skinny people put the extra fat partly into subcutaneous and intramuscular fat, which helps them look fuller
Building muscle isn't hard, it takes a long time; mixing up long and hard makes people quit
There's no rule that skinny people should train under 55 minutes; training volume doesn't make muscle eat itself, which is caused by long fasting
Train as long as you need to damage the muscle; skinny beginners have low work capacity, so their sessions start shorter and grow over time
At 160 lb as his best, the article's author is too small to be taking advice from
